newsitem.title: USA: WebSecure hires lawyer for Centennial case.
newsitem.headline: WebSecure hires lawyer for Centennial case.

text.p: WebSecure Inc said Friday it has decided to hire a law firm to advise the company on the validity of certain software licenses and contracts in which former Centennial Technologies Inc Chief Executive Emanuel Pinez may have been involved.

The company said the licenses under review are not part of its current ongoing business operations. However, WebSecure said they represented a "substantial" portion of the revenues reported for the quarter ended November 30, 1996.
The company said it also authorized the law firm, Hill & Barlow, to hire an accounting firm to determine the financial effect, if any, of those transactions.
The company said it is too early to determine if there will be any financial effect from the review.
Pinez, who is being held on securities fraud charges, was denied bail on Friday by a U.S. magistrate.
Pinez was fired from Centennial on February 11 after the company began an investigation into the accuracy of its financial results.
